description.en: MCP connector that drives a running AutoCAD with T20/T30 Tianzheng: axis grids, walls, doors, windows, columns, stairs, balconies, slabs, rooms, dimensions, symbols, title frames and sheet layout. Every capability is reported together with an entity-count delta so each change is measurable. Door and window insertion requires Tianzheng's own MC command, so the plugin generates a position list and verifies the result afterwards.
description.zh: MCP 连接器，驱动运行中的 AutoCAD 与天正建筑 T20/T30：轴网、墙体、门窗、柱、楼梯、阳台、楼板、房间、尺寸、符号、图框与排版。每项能力都随结果返回实体计数增量，改动可量化核对。门窗插入必须走天正自身的 MC 命令，插件因此生成位置清单并在事后核对结果。
